method.scope: Sections 1 through Conclusion from sections.tex and its recursive inputs; no headings, tables, figures/captions, references or appendices. Main captions flagged separately.
method.macros: Expand zero-argument newcommand/renewcommand definitions from generated/*facts.tex. Expanded values retain invocation source location and macro name.
method.sentences: Split on full stops only (not semicolons, colons, question marks or paragraph breaks); protect decimal points, leading-decimal fractions, listed standard abbreviations and initial sequences. A nonempty final fragment counts as a sentence.
method.words: English alphabetic words, contractions, numeric literals and alphanumeric hyphen compounds; an internal ASCII/nonbreaking hyphen keeps a compound as one word. Math command names and symbols do not count; readable inline letters/numbers count. Displayed formulas omitted from writing statistics.
method.term_matching: Case-insensitive whole words/phrases. establish and qualify include common inflections; audit/readback/archive/receipt/analogue include common inflections. Codes match whole alphanumeric tokens, including textual occurrences in captions.
method.number_inventory: Values expanded before inventory. Categories distinguish abstract, main_body, main_body_math, main_captions, main_table_data, main_table_notes and appendix equivalents. Citations, labels, refs, URL targets, headings and layout widths are removed. Scientific-notation TeX is recorded as its literal numeric components, and the surrounding expression remains in context/fingerprints. Numbers inside model codes are excluded by alphanumeric boundaries. Literal numbered Section/Table/Figure/Equation/Step references are excluded separately; 24-step prediction horizons remain substantive numbers.
method.numeric_comparison: Each surviving AFTER empirical number must find an identical normalized value and percent/nonpercent unit in the BEFORE evidence pool, with source context retained. Removed occurrences are expected after condensation. Repeated existing values are allowed but flagged when an AFTER count exceeds BEFORE; counts alone cannot prove claim equivalence. A change in rounding requires an explicit documented exception, never automatic acceptance.
method.immutability: Table numeric sequences and inline-math sequences must match exactly in order. All body display formulas are whitespace/label-normalized and compared as a multiset; editorial relocation is allowed. Raw source/figure hashes are also reported for independent provenance.
